_comment: DO NOT EDIT: generated by tools/mc/dedi/make_egg.py
name: Firn Minecraft Server
author: justin@fleitec.com
description: Minecraft Java 1.20.1 (protocol 763) dedicated server written in Firn. One static binary, no Java. Reads server.properties, console over stdin, saves vanilla worlds.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e
INSTALL_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
BINARY_FILE="${BINARY_FILE:-firnmc-server}"
ASSET="firnmc-server-linux-x86_64"
BASE="${FIRN_RELEASE_URL%/}"
if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then
    echo "FIRN_RELEASE_URL is empty"
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR/logs"
cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
echo "Downloading $BASE/$ASSET"
curl -fSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "$BINARY_FILE.download" "$BASE/$ASSET"
if curl -fsSL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 20 -o SHA256SUMS.download "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"; then
    expected=$(grep " $ASSET\$" SHA256SUMS.download | cut -d' ' -f1)
    actual=$(sha256sum "$BINARY_FILE.download" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    rm -f SHA256SUMS.download
    if [ -z "$expected" ] || [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
        echo "Checksum mismatch for $ASSET"
        rm -f "$BINARY_FILE.download"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Checksum ok"
else
    echo "No SHA256SUMS found, skipping the checksum"
fi
mv -f "$BINARY_FILE.download" "$BINARY_FILE"
chmod +x "$BINARY_FILE"
echo "Installed $BINARY_FILE"

variables.name: Release URL
variables.description: Directory URL that holds firnmc-server-linux-x86_64 and SHA256SUMS. Used by the installer (reinstall updates the binary, worlds stay).

variables.name: Binary file
variables.description: Name of the server executable in the server directory.

variables.name: Server name (MOTD)
variables.description: Message of the day in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Maximum number of players (the server caps this at 32).

variables.name: World folder
variables.description: Name of the world folder (a vanilla 1.20.1 world with level.dat).

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Only whitelisted players may join (true or false).
